PostToolUse.windows: powershell -Command "if ($env:TOOL_NAME -eq 'create_file' -or $env:TOOL_NAME -eq 'replace_string_in_file' -or $env:TOOL_NAME -eq 'multi_replace_string_in_file') { $files = $env:FILE_PATHS -split ';'; foreach ($file in $files) { if ($file -match '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json)$') { npx prettier --write $file } } }"
